summary: Rating summary component for Buy Box with reviews button linking to the review section.
features: Reviews button with link to review section
shortDescription: The Rating Summary component integrates into the product Buy Box to display aggregate review data with social proof. It includes a clickable reviews button that scrolls users to the full review section. The default configuration is horizontal, small, and left-aligned, matching typical Buy Box layouts. Merchants can hide the component entirely or customize both the layout variant and star styling to fit their product page design.
